text:
aliya: hey — heads up, deploy-bot rejected the staging publish for redwood/service-api:staging-20260320. looks like manifests differ between us-east-1 and eu-west-1 (two digests). anyone touched the image push pipeline?

deploy-bot: automated: publish check failed — manifest-digest-mismatch across replication targets. details: us-east-1 sha256:aaabbb111222333..., eu-west-1 sha256:cccddd444555666... action: HOLD_PROMOTE.

sam: weird. that tag should be exact from the CI build. did the builder retry with different base layer? can you paste deploy-bot logs?

deploy-bot: logs snippet:
```text
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name redwood/service-api --image-ids imageTag=staging-20260320
Found images: digests: sha256:aaabbb111222333..., sha256:cccddd444555666...
```

matt: possible race — mirror job processed a partial push then a republish finished later. we should not promote tag until regional manifests match.

oncall-sre: +1 block release. plan: pin by digest for rollback. what's previous stable digest?

sam: previous stable: sha256:999eee000aaa111... we can roll back staging to that digest and redeploy canary.

release-manager: please update release notes and hold change window until mirroring confirmed. @matt can you run the reconcile script and open a short PR to deploybot preflight?

matt: running reconcile now. command:
```bash
./scripts/reconcile-manifests --repo redwood/service-api --tag staging-20260320 --targets us-east-1,eu-west-1
```

matt: reconcile result: found orphaned layer in eu-west-1, re-pushed manifest using ci-artifact sha256:aaabbb111222333..., then triggered promote. verifying...

deploy-bot: verify check: all digests now match: sha256:aaabbb111222333... across targets. promote allowed.

aliya: thanks — we'll keep the change window but proceed with canary after 10m. will add a CI check to fail if regional digests differ (PR incoming).

release-manager: good. also add a release-note bullet: "staging publish paused due to cross-region manifest mismatch; reconciled and promoted — added preflight manifest check".

oncall-sre: follow-up: add alert if manifest mismatch frequency > 1/week. :eyes: 

sam: FYI adding a short postmortem note in #postmortems if this recurs.
